title: First run
subtitle: What this instance is bound to, and whether its database and provider answer
unreachable: The backend did not answer, so its setup state cannot be read.

state.heading: Instance state
state.body: Reported by the server on every load; nothing here writes to it.
state.ready: Bound and ready for a first conversation.
state.requiredBody: This build answers SINGLE_USER_UNSUPPORTED for the wizard write endpoints (database, initial-admin, finish). A single-user instance binds SQLite and creates its owner at boot, so there is no step to complete here.

database.heading: Database probe
database.body: Read-only connectivity test against a candidate control-plane database.
database.sqlitePathHint: Empty probes the default path under the HappyClaw home.

provider.heading: Provider probe
provider.body: Sends one test request. The key is used for this call only; add providers for real in Settings.
